facts.statement: For a limited time, buying a dog or cat for 400 Station Cash gave a free cat or dog outfit matching the pet.
facts.quote: ein Hund oder eine Katze für 400 Station Cash kauft

facts.statement: The promotion ran from 10 February 2012 at 09:01 until 15 February 2012 at 08:59 CET.
facts.quote: startet am 10. Februar um 09:01 Uhr und endet am 15. Februar 2012 um 08:59 Uhr CET

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A German-language SOE promotion offering a free cat or dog outfit with the purchase of a pet for 400 Station Cash, running from 10 February 2012 09:01 to 15 February 2012 08:59 CET. It lists 15 outfit-to-pet pairings (10 dog, 5 cat). The article is a limited-time offer, so it describes the live game only for that window.
